name: Conductor
desc: A tailcoated conductor drawn in dusty white chalk, back to the hall, the baton carving the 4/4 ictus pattern and leaving a fading chalk trail while both arms lift with the swell and the coat-tails sway.

energy.doc: baton arc size / sway / bob amplitude

pose.doc: auto flourishes on peaks; flourish = big arcs, arms high; rest = small low pattern

style.doc: aesthetic: white chalk on green board / graphite on paper / pure black silhouette / glowing tube-chalk / near-monochrome noir

act.doc: multi-minute program: concert = steady 4/4; crescendo = arms climb section by section; largo = half-tempo broad strokes
